activities.name: To Temper Thyself and Journey Far
activities.description: Fifth edition of the Battle Pass growth system, containing character development materials and rewards.

activities.name: The Godforsaken Frostlands
activities.description: Complete exploration missions for the new Snezhnaya areas within the specified duration to obtain an additional Primogems ×400.

activities.name: Tabletop Troupe: A Gathering on Adventure's Eve
activities.description: Choose a limited 5-star character (Tartaglia, Nilou, Baizhu, Chiori, Clorinde, or Varesa) to join your party.

activities.name: Across the Frozen Wilds, Honing One's Edge
activities.description: Choose a permanent 5-star character from the Standard Wish to join your party.

activities.name: Raiment Collection: Warmth of a Sunny Day
activities.description: Complete event tasks to accumulate progress; once enough progress is earned, claim the selectable "Afternoon Nectar" outfit set (4-Star).

activities.name: A Rekviem for the Underworld
activities.description: Complete Archon Quests Chapter VII: Acts III and IV and the subsequent interlude quests within the specified duration to obtain Primogems, Character Ascension Materials, Character Level-Up Materials, and other rewards.

activities.name: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
activities.description: Version event: complete challenges to obtain the event-exclusive weapon "Silver Light," Primogems, Crowns of Insight, and more.

activities.name: Rainbow's End: Resplendent Starlight
activities.description: Login reward event featuring mail-in gifts and cumulative login bonuses, awarding up to 1600 Primogems, 10 Intertwined Fates, and more.
